lessons.text: Before treating the Build gate's chained tsc/biome/vitest command exit code as a real failure, independently confirm any biome error is inside this feature's diff range (git log/diff on the flagged file against the pre-feature baseline) — a pre-existing, out-of-scope formatting issue elsewhere in the repo will otherwise always break the && chain before vitest runs and must be handled by running vitest as a separate step, not treated as a gate failure.
